preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 20,000.
The number of citizens m is between 1 and 10,000.
Each road connects two distinct cities.
Each citizen lives in a city and works in another city.
A citizen does not live and work in the same city.

postconditions.description: The total number of puppies needed k is between 1 and n.
The number of puppies given to citizens q is between 0 and the minimum of m and k.
The number of puppies given to guardians e is between 0 and the minimum of n - 1 and k.
The sum of the number of puppies given to citizens and guardians is equal to the total number of puppies needed k.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= m for ai in a1, a2, ..., aq)
postconditions.description: Each citizen index ai to receive a puppy is between 1 and m.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= bi <= n - 1 for bi in b1, b2, ..., be)
postconditions.description: Each guardian index bi to receive a puppy is between 1 and n - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(xi != yi for i in 1, 2, ..., m)
postconditions.description: Each citizen lives and works in different cities.
